product_metadata.title: Valieno Portable Air Conditioner
features: ❉【3 in 1 Air Cooler Fan】The portable desktop air cooler is an cooling fan, also has the functions of humidifier/ Purifies, you can have a feeling of spray diffuser, a air cooler achieves multiple functions perfectly.
❉【3 Adjustable Wind Speed】The usb desk fan cooler has 3 gear wind speed (low, medium, high, ) and sprays mode button, makes you spend the hot summer. modifying the dry dirty air into cooling air.

❉【Easy to Operate & Guidelines】Just put water into the air cooler and press the button. l. Press the power button once to turn it on 2. Press twice to switch to the second gear 3. Press three times to switch to the third gear 4. Press four times to turn it off 5. When the power button is turned on, the spray button will work when you press it once and it will be turned off after pressed twice.

❉【150ML Water Tank】The portable air cooler equiped with a tough capacity water tank, up to 150ml, you can add water or ice cubes, easy to use and low power consumption. which was envoirnment friendly. Work powerfully at a low noise level, let you sleep comfortably all night.

❉【Why choose us】Our cooler fan was Light and portable, easy to clean, suitable for bedroom, office, dormitory and other spaces. Connect usb-c cable to computer, laptop, power bank etc.Notice: the air cooler fan can't cool whole room, it's for individual use.
